posture.exposedTitle: Your password is the only thing protecting this account
posture.exposedBody: Anyone who learns it is in. Adding a second step takes about two minutes and stops that outright.
posture.basicBody: A stolen password alone won't get anyone in. A passkey would also block the fake login pages that codes can't.
posture.strongBody: Nothing to type means nothing to phish. Add an authenticator app as a backup for when your device isn't to hand.
posture.maximumBody: A passkey for everyday sign-in and an authenticator app to fall back on. Nothing more to do here.
